buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Manufacturer’s Authorization The bidder shall submit a valid Manufacturer’s Authorization Letter (MAF) i ssued by the Original Equipmen t Manufacturer (OEM) or authorized manufacturer, wherever applicable. T he authorization letter must spec ifically mention the relevant GeM Bid Number and Bid Title. It must be du ly signed by the authorized signa tory and bear the official stamp of the issuing company. The date of issu e must be clearly mentioned, and the authorization must remain valid for the bid and supply period. 2. Non-Blacklisting Declaration The bidder shall submit a self-declaration on its official letterhead stating th at the firm/company has not be en blacklisted, debarred, or banned by any Central Government Departme nt, State Government Departme nt, Government PSU, or other Government organization as on the date of submission of the bid. The declar ation must be duly dated, signed by the authorized signatory, and stamp ed with the firm's official seal. 3. Acceptance of ATC The bidder shall submit the complete Additional Terms and Conditions (ATC) docume nt with each page dul y signed and stamped by the authorized signatory as a token of unconditional accep tance. The document must clearly mention the relevant GeM Bid Number and Bid Title. The date of signing must be clearly ment ioned. 4. Bid Number and Document Dates The GeM Bid Number and Bid Title must be mentioned on the Manufa cturer’s Authorization Letter and ATC Acceptance wherever specified under these clauses. All declarations and supporting documents must bear proper issue/signing dates. Documents must be valid, legible, compl ete, and applicable to the current bid. Undated, unsigned, incomplete, or unauthenticated documents may be treated as non-compliant, subject to applicable GeM rules. 5. Local Seller Requirement The bidder must comply with the applicable GeM seller eligibility requirements and local supplier provision s, wherever specified in the bid. The bidder shall submit the relevant declarati on and supporting document s required to establish its local supplier status, including applicable Class-I or Class-II local supplier classification, wherever required under the prevailing Public Procurement (Preferenc e to Make in India) Or der and bid conditions. Any local content declaration must be accurate and supporte d by records when req uired. 6. Document Authentication All declarations, undertakings, and certificates submitted by the bidder must be duly signed by the authori zed signatory and bear the official stamp/seal of the bidder, wherever applic able. Manufacturer-issued doc uments must be signed and stamped by the issuing manufacturer or its aut horized representative. The bid der shall ensure that all submitted documents are genuine and verifiable. 7. Product Compliance The bidder shall supply products strictly conforming to the specifications, quantities

, quality standards, and other requirements mentioned in the GeM bid. The offered products must be genui ne, unused, and supplie d in their original packaging, with applicable batch numbers, manufacturing dates , expiry dates, and stora ge instructions wherever relevant. 8. Validity and Shelf Life All diagnostic kits and laboratory reagents supplied must have adequate remainin g shelf life at the time of delivery, in accordance with the bid specifications and applicable product require ments. Products must be transported and stored under the manufacturer-prescribed conditions. 9. Statutory and Regulatory Compliance The bidder shall ensure compliance with applicable Indian laws, lic ensing requirements, and regulatory sta ndards relevant to the offered products. Applicable CDSCO, IVD, medical device, or other regulatory docu mentation shall be provided wherever required for the specific pr oduct category. 10. Verification and Rejection The Buyer reserves the right to verify the authenticity and validity of docum ents submitted by the bidder. Any false, forged, misleading, or materially incorrect declaration may lead to rejection of the bid and furthe r action as .
